item.title: fix: process poll leaves notify-on-exit completion queued (#120585)
item.summary: fix: process poll leaves notify-on-exit completion queued (#120585) * fix(exec): acknowledge notify-on-exit after process poll * test(exec): mock completion event enqueue * fix: retire stale exec heartbeat wakes Prevent acknowledged process completions from turning their queued wake into an unrelated heartbeat. Preserve coalesced task work and keep stale wakes out of scheduler cadence and commitment follow-up. Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com> * test: isolate stale exec heartbeat coverage Keep existing heartbeat suites below the max-lines ratchet while retaining coverage for stale wake coalescing, scheduler bookkeeping, and commitment fan-out.
